Scale 2:1 | Units mm | Sheet 2 of 6 | scripts/draw_case.py
All dimensions from the model (scripts/case_dims.py); no draft angles modelled.
Tolerance: FDM print +/-0.2 unless noted; snap and peg features +/-0.05 as modelled.
Frame: x right, y down from the PCB's top-left corner, z up from the PCB's top face.
NOTES for an injection-moulded or machined version
1. No draft is modelled: add 1-2° on every face parallel to the pull (walls, standoffs, bosses, pegs).
2. Internal corners are sharp (only the vertical outside corners are R2): add R0.3-0.5 at wall/floor and boss roots.
3. Walls 2.2, plates 2.0 (antenna wall 2.5); the Ø4.0 standoffs and Ø4.4 bosses on 2 mm plates will sink: core or accept.
4. The tab bumps and skirt grooves are undercuts to a z pull: side actions or lifters, or accept a 0.2 mm bump-off.
5. The Ø2.15 pegs rely on FDM printing oversize to grip the Ø2.2 holes: size a true interference, or use inserts and screws.
6. Aluminium: 0.8 mm tabs cannot flex; use M2 screws through the bosses into tapped standoffs, and R1+ internal corners.
